question: If the lateral surface area of a right circular cylinder is 440 cm² and radius is 5 cm, find the height.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Lateral surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

440 = 2 × (22 ÷ 7) × 5 × h

440 = (220 ÷ 7) × h

h = (440 × 7) ÷ 220 = 14 cm

**∴ Answer = 14 cm**
